responsibility: Accept daily market-data CSV deliveries into Bronze or quarantine.

interfaces.input: handler.handler event: bucket/key/run_id/reference_date; landing/files/market_data/ only; CSV parsed by public market_data.parse.
interfaces.output: Bronze contract + erl_protocol.manifests.IngestionManifest in response and S3; invalid delivery in quarantine.

invariants: Prove contract codec before first write; preserve raw delivery, validate format/reference date, version-aware deduplication.
Conditional immutable output; manifest is commit; parse violations quarantine, infrastructure failures propagate.
external_resources: S3 landing/Bronze/raw/quarantine/manifests, CloudWatch; synchronous invocation; IAM supplied by Terraform.
state_and_effects: Reads its source landing prefix; writes raw, accepted Bronze or quarantine and manifests. No direct database access.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit lambda/market-data; own ZIP plus selected protocol modules and pinned native dependencies.
lifecycle.deploy: Own S3 package version and Lambda definition in project dev Terraform state.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test this unit from the selected Git commit and deploy its package; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Remove routing/callers and own function/package/IAM under approval; preserve shared buckets, contracts and committed data.
